findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/validate-command-timeout-smoke.ts:119,158,177 — new sections 6/7/8 create 3 fresh temp project roots via mkdtempSync(...) (each holding a written lattice.config.json) but never clean them up (no rmSync import/call anywhere in the file), unlike ~95% of comparable smoke tasks in packages/main/src/tasks/ (213/223 files using mkdtempSync also call rmSync, e.g. audit-esm-smoke.ts:7,37 which does `rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true })`). Because this file is registered in lattice.config.json validate.commands (line 59, focus: fast) and therefore runs on every `lattice validate` invocation going forward, this leaks 3 stray tmpdir directories per run indefinitely — a real, compounding resource-hygiene regression, not a one-off test artifact.
